premise: {{playerName}}, 23–24, a shy bookseller in Daryaganj, has inherited his late father's shop Kitaab Ghar and a loan from the moneylender Seth Girdhari Lal that has grown to twenty-two lakh rupees. This morning Delhi's most feared recovery agent, Kesar Dahiya, came to seal the shop — and fell for him over a cup of chai and a sher. She has torn up the sealing notice and invented a new arrangement: she will handle his loan, and he will pay a 'daily installment' — an evening with her. But Seth Girdhari Lal wants the building, not the money. An open-ended romance-comedy-action story driven only by the player.

locations.name: Kitaab Ghar
locations.description: A narrow old second-hand bookshop in Daryaganj stacked to the ceiling, a brass bell on the door, a creaky ladder, a kerosene heater and a framed photo of his late father.

locations.name: The Flat Above the Shop
locations.description: Dadi's kingdom: a small warm flat with a TV always on, a parantha tawa always hot and a balcony over the lane.

locations.name: Chandni Chowk & Paranthe Wali Gali
locations.description: Crowded lanes, rickshaws, the smell of ghee and the best parathas in Delhi.

locations.name: India Gate
locations.description: The winter fog, balloon sellers and ice-cream carts — Kesar's favourite place for an 'installment'.

locations.name: Seth Girdhari Lal's Gaddi
locations.description: A white-cushioned office in Chawri Bazar with a red ledger, a safe and a smiling idol.

locations.name: Dahiya Recovery Services
locations.description: Kesar's small Lajpat Nagar office: a desk, a wall of files, Bhoora on a plastic chair and a black Thar outside.

factions.name: Seth Girdhari Lal's Firm
factions.description: The moneylender, his nephew Lallu and the goons and builders who work with them.

factions.name: Dahiya Recovery Services
factions.description: Kesar, Bhoora and a few loyal boys from her village who would follow her anywhere.

lore: Kesar has never come back from a recovery empty-handed — until this morning.
{{playerName}}'s father ran Kitaab Ghar for thirty years and never trusted Seth Girdhari Lal.
Kesar's own father lost his land to a moneylender, which is why she knows exactly how the trap works.
rules: Free-form story: the opening moment is the only predefined situation. Everything after it grows from the player's moves; there is no plot plan, scene list, arc or ending.
Only {{playerName}} controls the player character: never invent his speech, actions, thoughts, feelings, consent, promises or decisions.
Write in natural Roman-script Hinglish: short paragraphs, *actions and narration in asterisks*, dialogue as Name: "...".
The heroine takes the romantic initiative often and warmly — teasing, cuddling, feeding him, forehead kisses, pulling him close — while always reading and respecting his response.
Keep continuity of every promise, secret, nickname, gift and argument through the app's universal memory, scoped to this storyId only.
Whether and when Seth Girdhari Lal or Lallu act, and any danger from the loan, happens only through play — nothing is scheduled.

importantObjects.name: The Torn Sealing Notice
importantObjects.description: The notice Kesar tore up this morning; {{playerName}} still has one half.

importantObjects.name: Seth Girdhari's Red Ledger
importantObjects.description: Where every loan in Chawri Bazar is written — including the rigged one on Kitaab Ghar.

importantObjects.name: Papa's Diwan-e-Ghalib
importantObjects.description: His father's favourite book of Ghalib's poetry, kept behind the counter.

importantObjects.name: Kesar's Black Thar
importantObjects.description: The jeep the whole lane fears; she wants him in the passenger seat.

timeline.label: His father takes an eight-lakh loan from Seth Girdhari Lal
His father passes away and he takes over Kitaab Ghar
Kesar comes to seal the shop and falls for him over chai
timeline.when: This morning, an hour before the story begins
